questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 14 cm and a height of 4 cm. What is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 14 × 4 = 28 cm². Slow down and halve — don't just multiply.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A closed cylinder has radius 5 cm and height 9 cm. What is its total surface area? (use π ≈ 3.14, round to 1 decimal place)

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Total surface area = 2πr² + 2πrh = 2(3.14)(25) + 2(3.14)(5)(9) = 157 + 282.6 = 439.6 cm². The distractors miss one part of the formula.

questions.prompt: In an open dish, why does the measured mass seem to decrease after burning wood?

questions.prompt: What is it called when a solid suddenly forms as two liquids react?
